name: Eventixa – Event Calendar, Event Tickets, Registration & Booking
author: Eventixa Team

sections.description:
Eventixa is a WordPress event calendar, event registration, event tickets, event booking, and event management plugin for creating and running events from one WordPress dashboard. Create free or paid tickets, accept registrations, manage bookings and attendees, take Stripe, PayPal or offline payments, use WooCommerce checkout, and organize venues, speakers, performers, sessions, and agendas without stitching together multiple event plugins.

Eventixa supports In-Person, Virtual events, and Hybrid events, including Custom URL online access with attendee access rules and timed link reveal. It also includes ticketing, checkout, attendee management, coupons, email tools, MailPoet integration, a guided Setup Wizard, and event migration tools for supported data from The Events Calendar ecosystem.

Live Demo | Documentation | Plugin Website | Upgrade to Pro

Whether you run conferences, workshops, seminars, classes, webinars, concerts, festivals, meetups, exhibitions, sports events, nonprofit events, school events, or business events, Eventixa keeps your event calendar, registrations, tickets, bookings, attendees, payments, and event administration connected.

Modern Event Calendar & Event Management

Eventixa works as a WordPress event manager, events calendar, and event management plugin with event listings connected to event registration, event tickets, and event booking.

Create and manage unlimited WordPress events with flexible dates, categories, venues, organizers, featured images, colors, search, filtering, event timezone handling, and responsive frontend views.

Core event management features include:

  • List View — Display upcoming events in a responsive event list.
  • Month / Calendar View — Show events in a monthly event calendar.
  • Day View — Display events scheduled for a selected day.
  • Event Search & Filters — Help visitors discover events by supported criteria.
  • Event Categories — Organize events for easier browsing and filtering.
  • Multi-day Events — Manage supported event schedules that span multiple days.
  • Venues & Geolocation — Reuse venue details, coordinates, maps, and directions where configured.
  • Organizers — Create and reuse organizer profiles.
  • Event Timezone — Process event dates and times using the configured timezone.
  • Event Images & Colors — Improve event discovery and presentation.
  • Event Duplication — Create a new draft from an existing event while keeping operational history separate.
  • Responsive Event Pages — Present event information across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Event Layouts

  • Grid View — Present events in a responsive card-based layout.
  • Map View — Display events using supported venue and map data.
  • Additional Single Event Layouts — Choose from additional event presentation templates.

In-Person, Virtual Events & Hybrid Events

Eventixa supports In-Person, Virtual, and Hybrid event formats. Virtual and Hybrid events can use a Custom URL for online attendance while keeping access information connected to the event and booking workflow.

  • Custom URL — Add the online meeting or streaming destination used by attendees.
  • Join Button Label — Customize the attendee-facing online access action.
  • Access Rules — Control supported access for everyone, logged-in users, confirmed attendees, or paid attendees.
  • Timed Reveal — Reveal protected online access immediately or according to supported event timing rules.
  • Event Page Access — Show online attendance details on supported single-event pages.
  • Booking & Account Access — Surface eligible Join actions in supported booking/customer areas.
  • Email Access — Include protected online attendance information in supported booking emails.
  • Calendar Support — Carry supported online event information into calendar/ICS workflows.

Eventixa Pro — Managed Virtual Event Integrations

  • Zoom Integration — Create, sync, and manage supported Zoom meetings from Eventixa.
  • Google Meet Integration — Create and manage supported Google Meet meetings through Google Calendar.
  • Recurring Meeting Support — Manage supported meeting workflows for recurring events.

Migrate from The Events Calendar

Moving from The Events Calendar? Eventixa includes event migration tools for bringing supported event data into the same event management workflow used for your event calendar, event tickets, event registration, bookings, and attendees.

Supported migration capabilities include:

  • Events — Import supported event records and scheduling data.
  • Categories & Tags — Preserve supported event taxonomy relationships.
  • Venues & Organizers — Bring reusable event location and organizer data into Eventixa.
  • Tickets — Import supported ticket definitions and ticket-related data.
  • Attendee Fields — Migrate supported attendee-field definitions.
  • Bookings & Attendees — Import supported historical registration, booking, and attendee records.
  • Virtual & Hybrid Events — Migrate supported online event data to Eventixa’s Core Virtual/Hybrid model, using Custom URL where appropriate.
  • Migration Controls — Fetch source events, select records, process migrations, pause/resume supported runs, retry failures, and re-import supported events.
  • Reconciliation & Reports — Review migration results and supported reconciliation information before and after import.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Migration Support

  • Recurring Events — Migrate supported recurrence and occurrence data.
  • Advanced Event Fields — Carry supported advanced event-field data into Eventixa.
  • Historical Check-in Data — Preserve supported attendee check-in information.
  • Managed Meeting Adoption — Carry supported Zoom or Google Meet meeting information when a compatible connection is available.

Event Tickets & Online Registration

Eventixa combines an event ticketing plugin and event registration plugin with its WordPress event calendar, keeping ticket sales, online event registration, attendees, and bookings connected.

Sell event tickets and accept online event registration directly from WordPress. Eventixa supports multiple ticket types, free and paid tickets, capacity control, ticket sale schedules, booking limits, attendee collection, and ticket availability management.

Core ticketing features include:

  • Multiple Ticket Types — Create different ticket options for the same event.
  • Free & Paid Tickets — Run free registrations or sell paid event tickets.
  • Ticket Capacity — Control available inventory and help prevent overbooking.
  • Ticket Booking Limits — Apply supported minimum, maximum, and availability rules.
  • Ticket Sale Scheduling — Configure when ticket sales open and close.
  • Sale Pricing — Configure supported ticket pricing and sale behavior.
  • Attendee Collection — Collect attendee information during registration.
  • Attendee Fieldsets — Configure supported attendee fields for the registration information you need.
  • Ticket Availability — Account for booking and inventory state during checkout.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Registration & Ticketing

  • RSVP Registration — Create Going and supported Not Going registration workflows.
  • QR Tickets — Generate QR-enabled event tickets.
  • PDF Tickets — Provide supported downloadable ticket documents.
  • QR Check-in — Validate tickets and manage attendee entry.
  • Advanced Ticket Controls — Use additional quantity and registration controls.

Event Booking & Checkout

Use Eventixa as an event booking plugin for free or paid WordPress events. The event booking system connects the event calendar, event registration, event tickets, attendees, checkout, and payments so booking data remains part of the same event management workflow.

  • Multi-step Checkout — Guide visitors through ticket selection, attendee details, and payment.
  • Guest Checkout — Let visitors register without creating a WordPress account when enabled.
  • Booking Management — Manage bookings and related registration information from WordPress.
  • Booking Status & Payment Status — Track supported booking and payment lifecycle states.
  • Booking Details — Keep tickets, attendees, customer details, and payment information connected.
  • Customer Booking Area — Give supported customers access to their booking information.
  • Checkout Session Handling — Protect ticket availability during active checkout sessions.
  • Booking Notes — Keep supported administrative notes with booking records.
  • Booking Confirmation Emails — Send booking-related notifications after registration events.

Eventixa Pro — Manual/Admin Bookings

  • Create supported bookings directly from WordPress administration for back-office registration workflows.

Event Payments: Stripe, PayPal, Offline & WooCommerce

Payment processing is integrated with the Eventixa event booking and event registration workflow. Visitors can choose tickets from event pages, complete registration, and use the supported checkout method while Eventixa maintains the event management and attendee context.

Eventixa Core supports PayPal, supported offline payments, free checkout, and WooCommerce checkout for event tickets and paid event registration. This supports WooCommerce event tickets while Eventixa keeps booking and attendee records connected.

  • PayPal — Accept supported online payments through Eventixa’s PayPal gateway.
  • Offline Payments — Accept supported local or offline payment methods.
  • Free Checkout — Accept registrations for free tickets without an online payment gateway.
  • WooCommerce Checkout — Use WooCommerce as the commerce layer for supported Eventixa checkout, configured payment gateways, taxes, coupons, currency, and customer account flows.

Eventixa Pro — Stripe Payments

  • Stripe – Accept supported event ticket payments through the native Stripe integration.

Attendee Management

Attendee management is connected directly to event registration, event tickets, and event booking. Administrators can move from the event calendar and event management screens to the related booking and attendee records without maintaining a separate attendee database.

Manage attendee records alongside Eventixa registrations, bookings, and tickets.

  • Attendee Records — Store attendee details associated with registrations.
  • Ticket Assignment — Connect attendees to the correct event ticket.
  • Attendee Fieldsets — Collect additional registration information using supported field types.
  • Registration Status — Manage attendee and booking-related registration state.
  • Attendee Lists — Review event attendees from WordPress administration.
  • Booking Relationships — Keep attendees linked to the corresponding booking and event.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Attendee Operations

  • QR Ticket Validation — Validate supported attendee tickets.
  • Attendee Check-in — Manage event entry and check-in status.
  • PDF Tickets — Provide supported downloadable attendee tickets.
  • Ticket Resend — Resend supported ticket communications when needed.

Venues, Organizers, Speakers, Performers & Event Agenda

Eventixa extends the WordPress event calendar beyond dates and listings with event venue management, event organizer profiles, speakers, performers, sessions, and agendas. These tools remain connected to event registration, event tickets, event booking, and the wider event management workflow.

For conferences and session-based events, Eventixa combines event management with reusable venues, organizers, Event Profiles, sessions, and structured agendas.

  • Venues — Reuse venue information across events.
  • Organizers — Create reusable organizer profiles.
  • Speakers & Performers — Create reusable Event Profiles and assign people to events.
  • Event Profiles — Publish supported profile information, biographies, social links, and related sessions.
  • Sessions — Add sessions with supported times, types, locations, and assigned speakers or performers.
  • Event Agenda — Display structured sessions on the single event page.
  • Multi-day Programs — Organize supported sessions across event schedules.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Agenda Features

  • Recurring Agenda Modes — Reuse or customize agendas across recurring occurrences.
  • Additional Agenda Layouts — Use additional presentation options for complex event programs.

Coupons & Ticket Discounts

Create coupon codes for supported event ticket bookings and apply discounts during checkout.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Coupons

  • Apply additional coupon rules, restrictions, and limits for more advanced promotions.

Event Emails & Bulk Email

Keep customers, attendees, and administrators informed with Eventixa email notifications.

  • Booking Confirmation Emails — Send registration and booking confirmation messages.
  • Booking Status Emails — Notify users about supported booking lifecycle changes.
  • Payment-related Emails — Send supported payment and booking information.
  • Admin Booking Notifications — Alert administrators about relevant booking activity.
  • Branded Email Settings — Configure supported branding, subjects, content, and placeholders.
  • Bulk Emails — Send targeted event communications with supported recipient selection, previews, testing, scheduling, and delivery history.

Eventixa Pro — Event Reminders

  • Send automated pre-event reminder emails using supported scheduling and recipient workflows.

Event Integrations

Eventixa connects event registration and event management data with supported WordPress and third-party tools.

  • MailPoet — Add configured event purchasers or attendees to selected MailPoet lists using supported global and event-level settings.
  • WooCommerce — Use WooCommerce checkout for supported Eventixa ticket transactions.
  • Elementor — Use supported Eventixa widgets and integrations with Elementor.
  • Gutenberg — Use Eventixa’s supported WordPress block integrations.

Eventixa Pro — Additional Integrations

  • Mailchimp — Connect configured purchasers or attendees to Mailchimp audiences and tags.
  • Zoom — Create and manage supported Zoom meetings.
  • Google Meet — Create and manage supported Google Meet meetings through Google Calendar.
  • Stripe — Accept supported event ticket payments through Stripe.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Event Management

Eventixa Pro extends the same event calendar, event registration, event tickets, event booking, and event management workflow with advanced capabilities.

Eventixa Pro features include:

  • RSVP Events — Going and supported Not Going registration workflows.
  • Recurring Events — Daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and custom recurrence with occurrence-level management.
  • Zoom Integration — Create, sync, and manage supported Zoom meetings.
  • Google Meet Integration — Create and manage supported Google Meet meetings through Google Calendar.
  • Stripe Payments — Accept supported ticket payments through Stripe.
  • QR Tickets & Check-in — Generate QR-enabled tickets, validate tickets, and manage attendee entry.
  • PDF Tickets & Invoices — Provide supported downloadable ticket and invoice documents.
  • Event Waitlist — Capture demand for sold-out tickets and promote eligible waitlisted users when capacity becomes available.
  • Reports & Revenue Analytics — Review supported booking, revenue, attendance, and event performance information.
  • Event Reminders — Send automated pre-event reminder emails.
  • Advanced Event Fields — Add additional event field types and conditional behavior.
  • Advanced Coupons — Apply additional coupon rules, restrictions, and limits.
  • Manual/Admin Bookings — Create supported bookings directly from WordPress administration.
  • Premium Event Layouts — Use Grid View, Map View, additional single-event templates, and agenda layouts.
  • Recurring Sessions & Agenda Modes — Reuse or customize agendas across recurring occurrences.
  • Mailchimp Integration — Connect configured purchasers or attendees to Mailchimp audiences and tags.

Upgrade to Eventixa Pro

External Services

Eventixa integrates with optional third-party services. Data is sent to a third-party service only when the related integration or payment method is configured and used.

PayPal
Used for supported online payment processing when the PayPal payment method is enabled.
Privacy Policy: https://www.paypal.com/privacy

Google Maps
Used for supported venue map and location functionality when map features are configured and used.
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

MailPoet
Optional integration for adding configured event purchasers or attendees to selected MailPoet lists.
Privacy Policy: https://www.mailpoet.com/privacy-notice/

Optional advanced features can additionally connect to Stripe, Mailchimp, Zoom, and Google services when those integrations are configured and used. Refer to the Eventixa documentation for the services used by the features you enable.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Eventixa plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Eventixa through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Eventixa → Setup Wizard.
  4. Complete the setup steps and allow Eventixa to configure the required plugin pages and settings.
  5. Create your first event and configure event tickets, registration settings, venue, organizer, booking options, and event format.
  6. Publish the event and display your Eventixa event calendar on your WordPress site.

Need help? Read the complete setup guide: https://eventixawp.com/documentation/
sections.faq:
What type of WordPress event plugin is Eventixa?

Eventixa combines a WordPress event calendar, event registration plugin, event ticketing plugin, event booking plugin, and event management plugin in one connected workflow. You can publish an event calendar, create event tickets, accept event registration, manage event booking records, and administer attendees from WordPress.

Can Eventixa be used as an event calendar with tickets and booking?

Yes. Eventixa is an event calendar with event tickets, event registration, and event booking capabilities. The calendar and management tools share the same event, ticket, booking, and attendee context.

Is Eventixa a free WordPress event calendar plugin?

Yes. Eventixa Core provides event management, responsive event calendar views, event tickets, event registration, event booking, attendees, In-Person/Virtual/Hybrid events, migration tools, venues, organizers, speakers, sessions, coupons, email notifications, PayPal, offline payments, and supported WooCommerce checkout.

Can I sell event tickets with Eventixa?

Yes. Eventixa Core supports free and paid event tickets, multiple ticket types, capacity controls, ticket sale schedules, attendee collection, checkout, bookings, and supported online payments.

Does Eventixa support event registration and booking?

Yes. Eventixa includes online event registration, ticket selection, attendee collection, multi-step checkout, guest checkout when enabled, booking management, booking statuses, and confirmation emails.

Can I create virtual or hybrid events?

Yes. Eventixa Core supports In-Person, Virtual, and Hybrid event formats. Virtual and Hybrid events can use a Custom URL with supported access controls and reveal timing. Managed Zoom and Google Meet integrations are available as optional advanced features.

Can I migrate to Eventixa from The Events Calendar, WP Event Manager, Events Manager, Eventin, Sugar Calendar or EventPrime?

Yes. Eventixa currently supports migration from The Events Calendar and supported related event data. Migration from WP Event Manager, Events Manager, Eventin, Sugar Calendar and EventPrime is on our roadmap.

Can I use WooCommerce to sell Eventixa event tickets?

Yes. Eventixa Core can connect supported Eventixa ticket transactions to WooCommerce checkout while Eventixa manages the event, tickets, registrations, bookings, and attendees.

Can I accept PayPal payments for event tickets?

Yes. Eventixa Core includes a supported PayPal payment gateway. Supported offline payments, free checkout, and WooCommerce checkout are also available.

Which payment methods are available in Eventixa Core?

Eventixa Core supports PayPal, supported offline/local payment methods, free checkout, and WooCommerce checkout integration. Native Stripe is available as an optional advanced integration.

Can visitors book without creating an account?

Yes. Eventixa supports guest checkout when the guest checkout option is enabled.

Does Eventixa support RSVP registration?

Yes. RSVP registration with Going and supported Not Going workflows is available as an optional advanced feature.

Does Eventixa support recurring events?

Yes. Recurring events with occurrence-aware daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and advanced recurrence workflows are available as an optional advanced feature.

Does Eventixa include QR tickets and attendee check-in?

QR-enabled tickets, ticket validation, and attendee check-in workflows are available as optional advanced features.

Can attendees receive PDF tickets and invoices?

Supported PDF ticket and invoice functionality is available as an optional advanced feature.

Can I manage speakers, performers, sessions, and event agendas?

Yes. Eventixa Core includes reusable Event Profiles for speakers and performers, event sessions, and structured frontend agendas. Additional recurring agenda modes and presentation options are available for more complex programs.

Can I collect custom attendee information during registration?

Yes. Eventixa Core supports attendee fieldsets for collecting additional attendee information using supported registration field types.

Does Eventixa integrate with email marketing tools?

Yes. Eventixa Core includes MailPoet integration. Mailchimp audience and tag integration is available as an optional advanced integration.

Does Eventixa work with Elementor and Gutenberg?

Yes. Eventixa includes supported Elementor and Gutenberg integrations for event-focused WordPress pages and layouts.

Is Eventixa suitable for conferences, workshops, classes, concerts, and meetups?

Yes. Eventixa can be used for conferences, seminars, workshops, training events, classes, webinars, exhibitions, festivals, concerts, meetups, sports events, nonprofit events, and business events.

Is Eventixa mobile responsive?

Yes. Eventixa’s supported frontend event views and event pages are designed to work across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Where can I get help?

Visit the Eventixa documentation at https://eventixawp.com/documentation/ or the plugin website at https://eventixawp.com/.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Added Core support for In-Person, Virtual, and Hybrid event formats with Custom URL online access, attendee access rules, timed reveal, frontend/account access, email integration, and calendar support.
  • Added migration tools for supported data from The Events Calendar ecosystem, including events, taxonomies, venues, organizers, tickets, attendee fields, bookings, attendees, and supported Virtual/Hybrid data, with retry, re-import, reconciliation, and reporting workflows.
  • Refined Events, Bookings, Attendees, Coupons, Venues, Organizers, and Speakers & Performers administration for a more consistent Eventixa management experience.
  • Improved event settings, ticketing, attendee collection, booking details, checkout, stock/capacity handling, and related add/edit workflows while preserving existing event and booking data.
  • Improved WooCommerce event-ticket checkout compatibility and payment workflow handling.
  • Improved MailPoet integration compatibility and the shared integration architecture used by optional integrations and webhooks.
  • Added extensive Core/Pro compatibility, naming, data-preservation, code-cleanup, and stability refinements across the Eventixa codebase.

1.0.3

  • Unified Eventixa administration under a single, cleaner menu with contextual access to ticket and attendee-fieldset management.
  • Improved Events administration with smarter ordering for ongoing, upcoming, recurring, and recently completed events.
  • Improved event-management navigation and submenu ordering for faster access to bookings, attendees, categories, venues, organizers, coupons, reports, settings, and other tools.
  • Refined admin interface spacing, controls, integration cards, speaker/session management, and attendee actions for a more consistent WordPress experience.
  • Refined Speakers & Sessions layouts, recurring agenda controls, Event Profile proportions, and mobile participant grids.
  • Improved single-event section spacing and typography for clearer frontend presentation.
  • Improved contextual ticket and attendee-fieldset workflows while preserving existing management screens and functionality.
  • Added Speakers & Sessions management with reusable Event Profiles and structured frontend agendas.
  • Added Duplicate Event support for Eventixa event data, speakers, and sessions, with compatibility for recurrence and recurring agenda mappings when available.
  • Added MailPoet integration with global and per-event recipient/list controls.
  • Added shared integration settings architecture for optional marketing integrations.
  • General UI polish, compatibility improvements, and release-readiness refinements.

1.0.2

  • Improved booking and attendee email workflows, placeholders, sender configuration, and ticket-related email behavior.
  • Improved checkout, payment, guest booking, ticket inventory, and coupon integration.
  • Improved Setup Wizard, settings synchronization, demo import reliability, admin metabox ordering, and booking notes workflow.
  • Fixed compatibility, validation, concurrency, and stability issues across Eventixa.

1.0.1

  • Improved Setup Wizard experience and onboarding.
  • Added demo content importer with sample events, venues, organizers, and tickets.
  • Added deactivation feedback to help improve Eventixa.
  • Improved plugin administration interface and overall user experience.
  • Added plugin action links for quick access to Settings, Documentation, and Get Pro.
  • Added plugin meta links for Documentation, Support, and Reviews.
  • Added global admin notices and important plugin announcements.
  • Fixed various UI issues and improved stability.
  • Performance improvements and minor bug fixes.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Complete event management solution for WordPress.
  • Create and manage events with categories, venues, and organizers.
  • Event calendar with supported Month, Day, and List views.
  • Event search and filtering.
  • Responsive frontend event listing and single event pages.
  • Ticket management with flexible pricing options.
  • Secure checkout and booking system.
  • Guest and logged-in user booking support.
  • Booking confirmation and booking details pages.
  • Customer My Account dashboard for managing bookings.
  • Organizer and venue archive pages.
  • Email notifications for bookings.
  • PayPal and supported offline payment workflows.
  • Event sharing and calendar export support.
  • Accessibility improvements and modern frontend UI components.
  • Theme compatibility with Astra, Blocksy, GeneratePress, Hello Elementor, Kadence, Neve, OceanWP, and WordPress default themes.
  • Optimized performance, security, and extensible developer architecture.

  • Offline Payments — Accept supported local or offline payment methods.
  • Free Checkout — Accept registrations for free tickets without an online payment gateway.
  • WooCommerce Checkout — Use WooCommerce as the commerce layer for supported Eventixa checkout, configured payment gateways, taxes, coupons, currency, and customer account flows.

Eventixa Pro — Stripe Payments

  • Stripe – Accept supported event ticket payments through the native Stripe integration.

Attendee Management

Attendee management is connected directly to event registration, event tickets, and event booking. Administrators can move from the event calendar and event management screens to the related booking and attendee records without maintaining a separate attendee database.

Manage attendee records alongside Eventixa registrations, bookings, and tickets.

  • Attendee Records — Store attendee details associated with registrations.
  • Ticket Assignment — Connect attendees to the correct event ticket.
  • Attendee Fieldsets — Collect additional registration information using supported field types.
  • Registration Status — Manage attendee and booking-related registration state.
  • Attendee Lists — Review event attendees from WordPress administration.
  • Booking Relationships — Keep attendees linked to the corresponding booking and event.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Attendee Operations

  • QR Ticket Validation — Validate supported attendee tickets.
  • Attendee Check-in — Manage event entry and check-in status.
  • PDF Tickets — Provide supported downloadable attendee tickets.
  • Ticket Resend — Resend supported ticket communications when needed.

Venues, Organizers, Speakers, Performers & Event Agenda

Eventixa extends the WordPress event calendar beyond dates and listings with event venue management, event organizer profiles, speakers, performers, sessions, and agendas. These tools remain connected to event registration, event tickets, event booking, and the wider event management workflow.

For conferences and session-based events, Eventixa combines event management with reusable venues, organizers, Event Profiles, sessions, and structured agendas.

  • Venues — Reuse venue information across events.
  • Organizers — Create reusable organizer profiles.
  • Speakers & Performers — Create reusable Event Profiles and assign people to events.
  • Event Profiles — Publish supported profile information, biographies, social links, and related sessions.
  • Sessions — Add sessions with supported times, types, locations, and assigned speakers or performers.
  • Event Agenda — Display structured sessions on the single event page.
  • Multi-day Programs — Organize supported sessions across event schedules.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Agenda Features

  • Recurring Agenda Modes — Reuse or customize agendas across recurring occurrences.
  • Additional Agenda Layouts — Use additional presentation options for complex event programs.

Coupons & Ticket Discounts

Create coupon codes for supported event ticket bookings and apply discounts during checkout.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Coupons

  • Apply additional coupon rules, restrictions, and limits for more advanced promotions.

Event Emails & Bulk Email

Keep customers, attendees, and administrators informed with Eventixa email notifications.

  • Booking Confirmation Emails — Send registration and booking confirmation messages.
  • Booking Status Emails — Notify users about supported booking lifecycle changes.
  • Payment-related Emails — Send supported payment and booking information.
  • Admin Booking Notifications — Alert administrators about relevant booking activity.
  • Branded Email Settings — Configure supported branding, subjects, content, and placeholders.
  • Bulk Emails — Send targeted event communications with supported recipient selection, previews, testing, scheduling, and delivery history.

Eventixa Pro — Event Reminders

  • Send automated pre-event reminder emails using supported scheduling and recipient workflows.

Event Integrations

Eventixa connects event registration and event management data with supported WordPress and third-party tools.

  • MailPoet — Add configured event purchasers or attendees to selected MailPoet lists using supported global and event-level settings.
  • WooCommerce — Use WooCommerce checkout for supported Eventixa ticket transactions.
  • Elementor — Use supported Eventixa widgets and integrations with Elementor.
  • Gutenberg — Use Eventixa’s supported WordPress block integrations.

Eventixa Pro — Additional Integrations

  • Mailchimp — Connect configured purchasers or attendees to Mailchimp audiences and tags.
  • Zoom — Create and manage supported Zoom meetings.
  • Google Meet — Create and manage supported Google Meet meetings through Google Calendar.
  • Stripe — Accept supported event ticket payments through Stripe.

Eventixa Pro — Advanced Event Management

Eventixa Pro extends the same event calendar, event registration, event tickets, event booking, and event management workflow with advanced capabilities.

Eventixa Pro features include:

  • RSVP Events — Going and supported Not Going registration workflows.
  • Recurring Events — Daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and custom recurrence with occurrence-level management.
  • Zoom Integration — Create, sync, and manage supported Zoom meetings.
  • Google Meet Integration — Create and manage supported Google Meet meetings through Google Calendar.
  • Stripe Payments — Accept supported ticket payments through Stripe.
  • QR Tickets & Check-in — Generate QR-enabled tickets, validate tickets, and manage attendee entry.
  • PDF Tickets & Invoices — Provide supported downloadable ticket and invoice documents.
  • Event Waitlist — Capture demand for sold-out tickets and promote eligible waitlisted users when capacity becomes available.
  • Reports & Revenue Analytics — Review supported booking, revenue, attendance, and event performance information.
  • Event Reminders — Send automated pre-event reminder emails.
  • Advanced Event Fields — Add additional event field types and conditional behavior.
  • Advanced Coupons — Apply additional coupon rules, restrictions, and limits.
  • Manual/Admin Bookings — Create supported bookings directly from WordPress administration.
  • Premium Event Layouts — Use Grid View, Map View, additional single-event templates, and agenda layouts.
  • Recurring Sessions & Agenda Modes — Reuse or customize agendas across recurring occurrences.
  • Mailchimp Integration — Connect configured purchasers or attendees to Mailchimp audiences and tags.

Upgrade to Eventixa Pro

External Services

Eventixa integrates with optional third-party services. Data is sent to a third-party service only when the related integration or payment method is configured and used.

PayPal
Used for supported online payment processing when the PayPal payment method is enabled.
Privacy Policy: https://www.paypal.com/privacy

Google Maps
Used for supported venue map and location functionality when map features are configured and used.
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

MailPoet
Optional integration for adding configured event purchasers or attendees to selected MailPoet lists.
Privacy Policy: https://www.mailpoet.com/privacy-notice/

Optional advanced features can additionally connect to Stripe, Mailchimp, Zoom, and Google services when those integrations are configured and used. Refer to the Eventixa documentation for the services used by the features you enable.
